rationale: v1.80.1 already classifies new wall faces using only splitRoomPath(activePath) and otherwise adds a nested room; composite closure can manufacture a third owner and leave an inert Save after rollback. This fixes that existing workflow without a new model or feature.

summary.ru: Исправлено создание комнаты через существующую перегородку и зависший диалог после отказа сохранения.
summary.en: Fixed room creation through an existing partition and an inert dialog after a refused save.
